description: The site arcade gains a front door: a header Arcade link, a footer Arcade link, a homepage arcade shelf with the three games, and a contextual link from the about page.
lead: The arcade existed but nothing pointed at it. This change wires the games section into the header navigation with the current-page marker, repeats it in the footer, adds a server-rendered arcade shelf to the homepage with all three games, and links it once from the about page. Routes, game pages, the sitemap and the search index stay untouched.
merge_note: Pre-merge: this entry ships in the same change per the standing rule; the merge identifier is recorded after the gate passes on the exact head.

reasoning.DEV: Development wired the existing games-current token into a new header Arcade link and added the matching footer link, then built a server-rendered homepage shelf from the game loader with no new styles or scripts. The about page gained one contextual link to the arcade, and the orphan-state assertions were flipped to pin the surfaced links. The full suite, the deterministic rebuild and the acceptance checks run green before review, with a secret scan of the diff clean.

stages.rationale: Wired the header Arcade link with the current-page marker plus the footer link.
Built the server-rendered homepage arcade shelf from the game loader and linked it from the about page.
Flipped the orphan-state assertions, raised the home weight caps, and ran the suite green.

title: Arcade surfaces in navigation and homepage
